components.name: Save
components.description: The primary document action; host theme supplies its colors.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8882); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; } .ds-primary, .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--wm-primary, #242428); color: var(--wm-primary-text, #fafafa); }

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Compact secondary document or canvas-view control.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8882); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

components.name: SVG path
components.description: Labeled path field in a native modal dialog.
components.html: <label for="ds-path" class="ds-label">SVG file</label><input id="ds-path" class="ds-path" placeholder="diagrams/architecture.svg">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin: 12px 0 6px; font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); } .ds-path { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); background: var(--wm-content, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--wm-hairline, #8885); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px; width: 100%; } .ds-path:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Source textarea
components.description: Secondary SVG source field, hidden by default and available under File.
components.html:
<textarea class="ds-source" aria-label="SVG source" spellcheck="false" wrap="off"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
</svg></textarea>
components.css: .ds-source { width: 100%; min-height: 140px; resize: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 12px 16px; font: 13px/1.65 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; tab-size: 2; white-space: pre; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); caret-color: currentColor; background: var(--wm-content, #fafafa); } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--wm-hairline, #8886); } .ds-source::selection { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8885); }

components.name: Canvas viewport
components.description: Image-context diagram rendering. The actual editor places its own numeric-geometry canvas overlay above the image for selection and gestures; document SVG never enters the application DOM.
components.css: .ds-viewport { overflow: auto; background: var(--wm-fill, #8881); cursor: grab; } .ds-viewport:active { cursor: grabbing; } .ds-viewport:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-canvas { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; } .ds-paper { display: block; flex: none; color: #242428; background: white; user-select: none; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Drawing tools
components.description: Six essential tools in a vertical sidebar; current tool is semibold with a tonal fill. Undo and Redo sit below.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8882); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; } .ds-tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 68px; height: 350px; padding: 6px 4px; gap: 4px; background: var(--wm-content, #fafafa); } .ds-tools .ds-button { padding: 6px 4px; } .ds-tools .ds-button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8882); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tool-space { flex: 1; }

components.name: Selection actions
components.description: Contextual row shown only while an object is selected; Edit text appears for text objects.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8882); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; } .ds-selection { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; gap: 4px; font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); } .ds-selected-name { margin-right: auto; color: var(--wm-text-dim, #73737b); }

components.name: File menu
components.description: Secondary document actions, source access and the keyboard-accessible object list.
components.html: File
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--wm-fill-strong, #8882); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; } .ds-file { position: relative; font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--wm-text, #242428); } .ds-file summary { padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-file summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wm-text, #555); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-file-actions { position: absolute; z-index: 10; top: 36px; left: 0; min-width: 180px; padding: 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--wm-surface, #fafafa); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px #0003; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-file-actions .ds-button { text-align: left; }

narrative.overview: A small canvas-first diagram editor inside Wonop. Its injected package styles and theme tokens are the visual authority. The drawing fills the window, with six essential tools and contextual object actions. Source is secondary, available under File. There is no independent website identity.
keyCharacteristics: Edge-to-edge canvas with a minimal drawing sidebar.
Explicit unsaved, recovery and error states.

rules.name: The Host Theme Rule
rules.body: Consume Wonop's injected tokens in both themes. CSS fallbacks support an unhosted page; they are not a separate palette. Do not substitute unrecognized surface-level tokens for `--wm-content`, `--wm-surface` or `--wm-fill`.

dos: Do inherit Wonop's light/dark tokens and native tab state.
Do keep canvas tools compact, keyboard reachable and visibly focused; keep source secondary.
Do preserve SVG colors independently of the surrounding theme.
donts: Don't add website chrome, a hero section or an independent brand palette.
Don't insert untrusted SVG markup into the live application DOM.
Don't conceal unsaved state, validation failures or draft recovery guidance.
